title: MikageObjectSpec
description: Locked schema for object-oriented design specs. Every renderable entity must pass through this before prompt compilation.

object_id.description: Unique identifier for this object definition

object_class.description: Top-level category: mask, weapon, vessel, garment, artifact, architecture, creature, symbol

identity_core.description: What this object IS at its most fundamental level

function.description: What this object does or represents

one_sentence.description: Single sentence: a viewer sees this and immediately knows it is ___

readable_as.description: Plain language: what a human viewer should immediately recognize this as. E.g. 'a Japanese fox mask made of white ceramic'

primary_form.description: Base geometric form: ovoid, cylindrical, planar, etc.

orientation.description: Default viewing angle: frontal, three-quarter, profile

silhouette_rules.description: What the outline MUST and MUST NOT look like

must_read_as.description: The silhouette alone must read as ___

key_contour_features.description: Contour landmarks that define the silhouette

forbidden_silhouettes.description: Silhouette shapes that would make this unreadable

must_have_parts.description: Parts that MUST be present for the object to be readable

forbidden_parts.description: Parts that must NEVER appear on this object

material_truth.description: What this object is actually made of

misread.description: What the AI might accidentally generate instead

common_misreads.description: Known failure modes where the AI generates the wrong thing

anti_misread_rules.description: Explicit rules to prevent common misreads

part_priority_order.description: Ordered list of parts from most important to least. Prompt compiler uses this to weight tokens.

approved.description: Whether this spec has been approved for render
